steps.title: Employee Weekly Timesheet Entry
steps.action: Employee enters daily hours across assigned project codes; clicks 'Submit'
steps.response: Dispatches timesheet to Supervisor Review Queue

steps.title: Manager Timesheet Review Queue
steps.action: Manager inspects pending team timesheets; clicks 'Review' on flagged row

steps.title: Line-Item Audit Inspection Modal
steps.action: Manager audits billable vs non-billable hours; chooses 'Approve' or 'Reject'
steps.response: Approval locks timesheet; Rejection opens Mandatory Reason Dialog

steps.title: Rejection Reason Dialog
steps.action: Manager enters mandatory correction explanation and confirms
steps.response: Reverts timesheet to 'Draft' status and sends email notification to employee
